examples.title: Move from JSON to MySQL for a server network
examples.goal: Bans, economy and permissions must be shared without copying files.
examples.result: Set `storage.type: mysql` and the `storage.mysql.*` block, then restart (not reload): the backend is chosen at startup. If a collection in MySQL is empty and `autoMigrate: true`, the mod imports the data once from the current JSON/legacy files. Old files are not deleted. If MySQL is unreachable at startup, the mod silently falls back to JSON and the server still starts.

edgeCases.title: Mail is not in the DataStore
edgeCases.body: `/mail` still lives in `config/neoessentials/mail_data.json` regardless of `storage.type`. Changing the backend does not move mail.
edgeCases.fix: On a server network, do not expect shared mail through MySQL — it is not there. The other collections (including auction_listings) are.

edgeCases.title: Gradle runServer does not see the sqlite/mysql/yaml drivers
edgeCases.body: The drivers are bundled via JarJar inside the built jar. The dev classloader of `runServer` cannot see them → ClassNotFoundException when type ≠ json. On an installed jar everything works normally.
edgeCases.fix: Keep `storage.type: json` locally. Test MySQL on the built mod, not with `gradlew runServer`.

edgeCases.title: Permissions are written in full, not per record
edgeCases.body: Most collections update a single document. `permission_groups` / `permission_users` replace the whole state on save(): otherwise deleting a group would leave a ghost in the backend.
edgeCases.fix: Do not edit a single line in `permission_users.json` while the server is running — the next save overwrites your edit with a full dump.
